blocks.text: Probability is the study of how likely an event is to happen. It helps us predict outcomes based on what we know.

Example: Consider flipping a coin. There are two possible outcomes: heads or tails. Since both outcomes are equally likely, the probability of getting heads is 50% (or 1/2), and the probability of getting tails is also 50%.
We can express this mathematically as:

blocks.latex: \text{Probability} = \frac{\text{Number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{Total nuber of outcomes}}
blocks.text_alt: Probability = Number of favorable outcomes / Total nuber of outcomes

blocks.text: In the case of the coin flip:
Probability of heads = (1 favorable outcome, 2 total outcomes)
Probability is not just for coin flips. It is used in many areas, such as predicting the weather, making business decisions, or even playing cricket.
Instructions: You will analyze a small dataset, calculate measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode), and measures of dispersion (variance and standard deviation).

items: Collect Data: Imagine you are surveying your classmates about the number of hours they spend on homework in a week. Gather data from 10 classmates. Record the number of hours (you can use any reasonable numbers, e.g., between 0 to 20 hours).

Calculate Measures of Central Tendency: • Mean: Calculate the average number of hours spent on homework. • Median: Determine the middle value when the hours are arranged in order. • Mode: Identify which number appears most frequently in your data.
Calculate Measures of Dispersion: • Variance: Use the formula to calculate variance based on your data. • Standard Deviation: Calculate the standard deviation using the variance you found.
Reflect: Write a brief reflection (3-4 sentences) about what these calculations tell you regarding your classmates' study habits.

blocks.text: For illustration, you can use the following sample data: 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18. But if you are interested in collecting real data from your classmates, you are welcome to do so.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Statistics can help us understand patterns in data, leading to better decision-making in various fields, from healthcare to marketing!

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Statistics is used in many everyday activities, such as predicting weather patterns or analyzing sports performance.
